title: yuhangshi888/sun-cotangent-permanent-counterexample-lean
abstract: A Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of the exact evaluation of the normalized 14 by 14 cotangent permanent at p = 29. The formalization proves that its value is 84643985981440 and hence gives a counterexample to the cotangent sign inequality in Zhi-Wei Sun's Conjecture 4.7(ii). It includes the analytic-to-cyclotomic bridge, two separately kernel-checked finite permanent certificates, Chinese-remainder and coefficientwise integer lifting, the Section 3 Archimedean uniqueness argument, and equation (4.1) in the integral cyclotomic quotient.
